exposure: merging of a mixed-risk birth unit and a midwifery-led low-risk unit into one mixed-risk unit
implementation of interprofessional preventative and mitigating measures
outcome: birth without intervention (with or without artificial rupture of membranes)
cohort: All women who had singleton births at the National University Hospital of Iceland (NUHI) birth units during 2-year periods before (2012-2013) and after (2015-2016) the unit merger.
finding: The rate of births without interventions, both with and without artificial rupture of membranes, increased significantly after the unit merger and accompanying preventative measures.
mod_finding: The rates of AROM, oxytocin augmentation, episiotomies, and epidural analgesia decreased significantly, while the rate of induction increased, with no significant differences found in maternal or neonatal complication rates.
